title: AI-human hybrid conversations: Can AI Agents Improve Discourse Quality?
abstract: arXiv:2611.33459v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversations are central to how people exchange information, share experiences, and develop collective understanding. Yet, across conversational settings, discussions often suffer from uneven participation, unanswered contributions, and a narrow range of perspectives. As generative AI agents increasingly participate alongside humans, hybrid human-AI conversations present a new opportunity to address these challenges. We investigate whether AI agents can serve as catalysts for human interaction, improving conversational engagement and broadening collective discourse. We develop a framework for introducing generic and persona-conditioned AI agents into evolving discussions and evaluate it through two complementary studies. First, using agent-based simulations grounded in Reddit discussions across four domains, we find that AI-generated conversations are more positive and less toxic than human conversations, but substantially less semantic

translated_title: AI-人类混合对话：AI智能体能否提升话语质量？
translated_abstract: 对话是人们交换信息、分享经验并形成集体理解的核心方式。然而，在各种对话场景中，讨论往往存在参与不均衡、发言得不到回应以及观点范围狭窄等问题。随着生成式AI智能体日益频繁地与人类共同参与交流，人机混合对话为应对这些挑战提供了新的机遇。我们研究了AI智能体能否充当人类互动的催化剂，提升对话参与度并拓宽集体讨论的范围。我们开发了一个将通用型和人设条件化（persona-conditioned）的AI智能体引入动态演化讨论的框架，并通过两项互补的研究对其进行评估。首先，基于四个领域中Reddit讨论进行的智能体模拟实验表明，AI生成的对话比人类对话更积极、毒性更低，但在语义（多样性/丰富度）上明显不足……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个将通用型和人格设定型AI智能体引入动态讨论的框架，并通过基于Reddit的模拟实验和互补研究发现，AI智能体有望成为提升人机混合对话参与度与话语质量的催化剂，使对话更积极、毒性更低。
